theorem bounded61 : boundedPowMul 1945555039024054272 2 1 56 = some 72057594037927936 := by decide +kernel
theorem table151 : isTablePrime 151 = true := by decide +kernel
theorem table331 : isTablePrime 331 = true := by decide +kernel
theorem fermat31 : HexArith.powModNat 3 2147483646 2147483647 = 1 := by decide +kernel
theorem unit : (true : Bool) = true := by decide +kernel
theorem fast31 : checkFast c31 = true := by decide +kernel
theorem fast61 : checkFast c61 = true := by decide +kernel
theorem pock31 : checkPockArith 2147483647 [(3,0,PrimeCert.small 151),(3,0,PrimeCert.small 331)] = true := by decide +kernel
theorem pockFast31 : pockFast 2147483647 [(3,0,PrimeCert.small 151),(3,0,PrimeCert.small 331)] = true := by decide +kernel

meta partial def inlineLocal (env : Lean.Environment) (e : Lean.Expr) : Lean.Expr :=
  e.replace fun sub => match sub with
    | .const n levels =>
      if env.isImportedConst n then none else
        match env.find? n with
        | some info => (info.value? (allowOpaque := true)).map fun value =>
            inlineLocal env (value.instantiateLevelParams info.levelParams levels)
        | none => none
    | _ => none


run_cmd do
  let env ← Lean.getEnv
  let original := env
  let ready ← IO.mkRef env.toKernelEnv
  let ready ← ready.get
  let env := Lean.Environment.ofKernelEnv ready
  let names := [`whole31, `whole61, `check31, `check61, `witness61, `fermat61, `half61, `product61, `bounded61, `table151, `table331, `fermat31, `unit, `fast31, `fast61, `pock31, `pockFast31, `subjects31, `subjectsFast31]
  for block in [0:4] do
    for name in (if block % 2 == 0 then names else names.reverse) do
      let some (.thmInfo info) := original.find? name | throwError "missing theorem"
      let value := inlineLocal original info.value
      let type := inlineLocal original info.type
      let proof := Lean.mkApp (Lean.mkLambda `h .default type (Lean.mkBVar 0)) value
      let input ← IO.mkRef (env, proof)
      for rep in [0:10] do
        let (env, proof) ← input.get
        let start ← IO.monoNanosNow
        let checked ← IO.mkRef (Lean.Kernel.check env {} proof)
        let checked ← checked.get
        let stop ← IO.monoNanosNow
        match checked with
        | .error _ => throwError "kernel rejected profile proof"
        | .ok _ => pure ()
        Lean.logInfo m!"PROFILE {block} {name} {rep} {stop - start}"

+      (boundedPowMul.go bound q acc e)
+      ((acc.ble (bound.shiftRight e)).rec none (some (acc.shiftLeft e))))

open Hex.Nat
@[expose] noncomputable def witnessesFast (n : Nat) (fs : List (Nat × Nat × PrimeCert)) : Bool :=
  List.rec (motive := fun _ => Nat → Bool → Bool) (fun _ _ => true) (fun x _ ih prev seen =>
    (seen.and (x.1.beq prev) |>.rec (motive := fun _ => Bool)
      ((HexArith.powModNat x.1 (n.sub 1) n).beq ((1 : Nat).mod n)) true).and
      ((Nat.gcd (((HexArith.powModNat x.1 ((n.sub 1).div x.2.2.subject) n).add n).sub 1 |>.mod n) n).beq 1 |>.and
        (ih x.1 true))) fs 0 false

@[expose] noncomputable def subjectsFast : List (Nat × Nat × PrimeCert) → Nat → Bool :=
  List.rec (fun _ => true) (fun x _ ih lower => (lower.blt x.2.2.subject).and (ih x.2.2.subject))
@[expose] noncomputable def pockFast (n : Nat) (fs : List (Nat × Nat × PrimeCert)) : Bool :=
  (2 : Nat).ble n && (n.mod 2).beq 1 && subjectsFast fs 1 &&
    (let f := pockProduct (n.sub 1) fs
     ((n.sub 1).mod f).beq 0 && n.blt (f.mul f) &&
       witnessesFast n fs)

@[expose] noncomputable def checkFast : PrimeCert → Bool :=
  PrimeCert.rec (motive_1 := fun _ => Bool) (motive_2 := fun _ => Bool)
    (motive_3 := fun _ => Bool) (motive_4 := fun _ => Bool)
    isTablePrime (fun n fs ih => (pockFast n fs).and ih)
    (fun n r s w fs ih => (checkPock3Arith n r s w fs).and ih)
    true (fun _ _ head tail => head.and tail)
    (fun _ _ ih => ih) (fun _ _ ih => ih)
